plugins.name: dct-pay
plugins.description: Add Korean payments to a vibe-coded web app without a business registration or PG contract. Docenty Pay (pay.docenty.ai) is the seller of record: hosted /pay checkout (bank transfer now; card, KakaoPay, NaverPay, TossPay and virtual accounts once the PG is connected), product pages, AlimTalk invoices, deposit checks, creator dashboard and monthly payouts. Zero-dependency CLI; web apps only (Next.js, React, Vite, static HTML).
